attr.title: Katamari Damacy
attr.desc: The original Katamari Android game running its ARMv5 native engine directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: Supply your own Katamari Android 1.0.0 APK, ZIP, or extracted folder. Put it in ports/katamari/; the first launch extracts and validates it automatically. No game data is included.
